truthQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_products on product_id = t_products.product_id } extend { dimension: line_margin is sale_price - t_products.cost, line_markdown is t_products.retail_price - sale_price } -> { aggregate: discount_off_list is line_markdown.sum() / (line_markdown.sum() + sale_price.sum()) }
verifyQuery: run: t_order_items extend { join_one: t_products on product_id = t_products.product_id } extend { dimension: line_margin is sale_price - t_products.cost, line_markdown is t_products.retail_price - sale_price } extend { dimension: line_discount is 1 - sale_price / t_products.retail_price } -> { aggregate: avg_line_discount is line_discount.avg() }
